data.null: placebo anchors m = 1..11 of years 1994-2025, train bars only (<= 2025-11-10)
data.source: Yahoo chart endpoint (keyless), dividend-adjusted daily closes, as research/lib/fetch.py writes research/data/adj

metric: placebo_rank (one-sided empirical p of a cross-sectional t against a frozen null; not one of forward.py's three metrics: needs adding at freeze)
note: Null: 153 placebo windows; t >= 4.87 needed for p <= 0.02. Power 0.08 at b* 0.089, 0.05 at half. Reads held-out-year bars as the dose only.

params.dose: YTD = log(close last bar of November Y / close last bar on or before 31 Dec Y-1); L = max(0, -YTD); loser = L > 0
params.eligible: >= 15 funds with dose and window, >= 3 losers
params.first_turn: tax year 2026 (31 Dec 2026 .. 8 Jan 2027); if not eligible, the next eligible turn
params.p: (1 + #null t >= t) / (1 + #null), null frozen in this entry
params.statistic: plain OLS t of the slope of R on L across funds, with an intercept
params.window: R = log(close last bar on or before 10 Jan Y+1 / close last bar on or before 31 Dec Y)
